A2–B1Real spoken Swedish

”Det blir bra” – svenskarnas universalsvar

“Det blir bra” – a favourite Swedish phrase for reassurance. You learn the difference between bli and vara (blir bra, blir kallt, blir svårt) and write a warm note to a friend who is worried.

Level
A2–B1
Topic

About the lesson

What happens in the lesson

The warm-up “Vad tänker du?”, the game “Orolig eller lugn?”, the text “Ett svar man hör ofta” about why Swedes so often say “det blir bra”, and a conversation about how people reassure each other where you come from. At home you write what people in your country say to comfort someone and compare it with “det blir bra”.

Suitable for students at level A2–B1 who study on their own, and for teachers who need a ready-made lesson of ≈ 60 minutes. The slides with answers help both with self-checking and during the lesson.

What you’ll learn

Language you can use straight away

📚

Key phrases

Phrases from the lesson text that you practise in the exercises.

  • ta det lugnt
  • ordnar sig
  • finns där för
  • må bra
  • känna sig trygg
🧩

Grammar

bli or vara: blir bra, blir kallt, blir svårt – a change of state versus a state that already exists.

💬

Practice

You write (on your own or with a partner) a warm note to a friend who is worried about an exam, a move or a job interview.

  11. DiscussionHur är det hos dig?optional · 6 min
